description:
## Why
387 tests; census (attached to fz-p8p as port.tsv): 329 assert only that the drive resolves, several discard the outcome (`let _ = compiler.drive()`), 342 TODOs name the intended claim, several contradict their names.

## What changes
- Resolves-only tests are deleted: once their fixture is in `fixtures/` the matrix proves it compiles and runs on three paths.
- Each TODO's intended claim becomes an in-language `assert` in its fixture (owner decision). A failing assert is a finding with its own ticket. TODOs naming diagnostic codes that do not exist are listed, not invented.
- The ~41 structural tests move to stage-appropriate test files through the harness.
- Their fixtures are deduplicated (e.g. 00389-00402 collapse into 00191-00207), given `purpose:`, and moved to `fixtures/`.
- Tests whose names contradict their bodies (`struct_type_alias_must_cover_all_fields`, `cross_module_import_resolves_external_call_edges`, `guard_partition_selects_refined_clause`) are renamed to what they prove or become bug tickets.

## Signal
Zero `port_*_test.rs` files.
title: Retire the nine port_*_test.rs files
